subject: Sandbox runway top-up request — CI gate failure delaying POC
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@blueholder.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Ravi Kapoor <ravi@blueholder.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox runway top-up and short extension request

Hi Mina,

Quick note from our side — we've hit a blocker in our CI that prevents the adapter from building on our side (fails during the integration test stage). Ravi has attached a short log excerpt. The engineering team estimates ~10 working days to resolve because a third-party dependency (image processing lib) needs a patch.

Because the POC demo window is slipping, can Redwood provide a small sandbox credit top-up (about $5k equivalent) and a 2-week extension on our trial window while we fix the CI? We really want to keep momentum — the execs are lined up for a demo the week after next but we can't deliver until the CI gate is green.

Attached: ci_failure_logs.txt (excerpt)

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful. Appreciate anything you can do to keep the pilot alive.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Integrations, BlueHolder
S: +1 (415) 888-1212

--
Attachment: ci_failure_logs.txt (plain text, 12KB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@blueholder.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Ravi Kapoor <ravi@blueholder.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox runway top-up and short extension request

Thanks for the context, Sanjay — and thanks Ravi for the logs. I read through the snippet and I can see why your CI is failing (we've surfaced similar flakes when the build matrix pulls newer system libs).

We want to keep the demo on track. Two quick asks so I can move this to approvals immediately:
1) Can you confirm the exact demo date window you need to hit (mm/dd range)?
2) Please upload a one-page mutual action plan (timeline + owner for the CI fix + acceptance criteria). That helps expedite credit approvals.

I'll request an initial runway top-up and a 2-week extension while your team remediates. Ben and Marcus — looping you in for credit allocation and formal extension sign-off.

If it's useful, I can propose a lightweight test harness change that often mitigates the transient failure while they patch the dependency (Ravi — ping me and I can put a short patch recommendation in our ticket).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0193

--
Attachment requested: mutual-action-plan.pdf

Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Sandbox runway top-up and short extension request (BlueHolder / DEAL-7831)

Marcus,

Forwarding BlueHolder's ask — Mina's already offered to help with a temporary harness change. Summary: customer requests ~ $5k sandbox credit top-up and a 2-week trial extension due to an integration CI failure blocking their POC demo. They expect ~10 business days to fully remediate.

Why I think we should approve:
- BlueHolder is in an active pilot with a strong probability to convert (deal stage: POC - exec demo scheduled).
- Extension and a modest credit top-up keep the momentum and reduce churn risk.

I've attached Mina's short note and the CI logs for context. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7831

If you approve, can we:
1) Issue a $5,000 sandbox credit allocation to BlueHolder's sandbox project (account id: BH-0092)
2) Apply a 14-day trial extension on their tenant
3) Send an amendment for signature (DocuSign) if needed for any contract change

I can create the amendment doc if you want; otherwise happy for legal to handle the DocuSign step.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0148

Notes for customer messaging: keep it concise and action-oriented. Suggested reply below that Mina / Ben can send to Sanjay.
